questions.explanation_english: Mandatory proactive disclosure under Section 4(1)(b)(ix) mandates every public authority to publish a comprehensive directory of its officers and employees. questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the authorities or bodies included under Section 2(h) of the RTI Act, 2005:
I. By or under the Constitution
II. By any other law made by Parliament
III. By notification issued or order made by the appropriate Government
IV. By a private resolution of an unaided school management committee

questions.explanation_english: Section 2(h) of the Right to Information Act defines a public authority as any authority, body, or institution of self-government established by or under the Constitution, by parliamentary or state law, or by government notification. It also includes non-governmental organizations substantially financed by government funds. Private resolution management of unaided schools does not constitute a public authority.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। सूचना के अधिकार अधिनियम की धारा 2(h) के अनुसार, सार्वजनिक प्राधिकरण को संविधान द्वारा या उसके अंतर्गत, संसद या राज्य कानून द्वारा, या सरकारी अधिसूचना द्वारा स्थापित किसी भी प्राधिकरण, निकाय या स्व-सरकार की संस्था के रूप में परिभाषित किया गया है। इसमें उन गैर-सरकारी संगठनों को भी शामिल किया गया है जो सरकारी धन से महत्वपूर्ण रूप से वित्त पोषित होते हैं। अनुदानित विद्यालयों के निजी प्रस्ताव प्राधिकरण नहीं बनाते हैं।
key_facts: Section 2(h) defines public authority.
Private unaided schools are not public authorities.
Printed answer key: (B) I, II, and III only

questions.question_english:
Which of the following correctly describes the
“Public Interest Override” under Section 8(2) of
the RTI Act?
options_english:
The Central Information Commission alone
holds exclusive statutory jurisdiction to
invoke Section 8(2) provisions.

The public interest override mechanism
applies strictly and exclusively to matters
concerning national security.

Information classified under the Official
Secrets Act, 1923 is permanently barred from
public disclosure under all circumstances.

questions.explanation_english: Access may be allowed if public interest outweighs harm, notwithstanding OSA 1923 or Section 8(1). Section 8(2) establishes the public interest override mechanism. A public authority may allow access to information if the public interest in disclosure outweighs the harm to protected interests, notwithstanding anything in the Official Secrets Act, 1923 or exemptions under Section 8(1), ensuring transparency when greater public good is established.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। यदि जनहित हानि से अधिक है, तो पहुँच की अनुमति दी जा सकती है, भले ही ओएसए 1923 या धारा 8(1) हो। धारा 8(2) जनहित ओवरराइड तंत्र की स्थापना करती है। एक सार्वजनिक प्राधिकरण जानकारी तक पहुँच की अनुमति दे सकता है यदि प्रकटीकरण में जनहित संरक्षित हितों को होने वाली हानि से अधिक है, जो आधिकारिक रहस्य अधिनियम, 1923 या धारा 8(1) के तहत छूटों के बावजूद है, जब अधिक सार्वजनिक भलाई स्थापित होती है।
key_facts: Section 8(2) provides for public interest override.
Printed answer key: (d) Access may be allowed if public interest outweighs harm.
Transparency is prioritized when public good is established.
Exemptions under Section 8(1) can be overridden.

questions.question_english: A citizen files an RTI application asking for the reasons behind a specific policy decision taken by the Directorate of Education. Which of the following is the legally correct stance for the PIO?
options_english: The PIO must justify the administrative decision and independently draft a complete rationale for the applicant.
The PIO must supply existing records.
The PIO must supply existing records, but need not formulate new reasons.
The PIO must disclose all reasons behind the decision.
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is that the PIO must supply existing records, but need not formulate new reasons. Section 2(f) of the RTI Act mandates Public Information Officers to provide information that is available in recorded form. When an applicant requests reasons behind a policy decision, the officer is obligated to supply existing records, file notings, or documents that contain those reasons. However, the officer is not legally required to draft or generate new justifications that are not already on record.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। PIO को मौजूदा रिकॉर्ड प्रदान करना होगा, लेकिन नए कारण तैयार करने की आवश्यकता नहीं है। RTI अधिनियम की धारा 2(f) सार्वजनिक सूचना अधिकारियों को रिकॉर्ड में उपलब्ध जानकारी प्रदान करने के लिए बाध्य करती है। जब आवेदक नीति निर्णय के पीछे के कारणों की मांग करता है, तो अधिकारी को मौजूदा रिकॉर्ड, फाइल नोटिंग या दस्तावेज प्रदान करने होंगे जो उन कारणों को शामिल करते हैं। हालांकि, अधिकारी को नए औचित्य तैयार करने की कानूनी आवश्यकता नहीं है जो पहले से रिकॉर्ड में नहीं हैं।

questions.explanation_english: Section 23 of the Right to Information Act contains a bar of jurisdiction of civil courts.
